from collections import Counter
from pathlib import Path
root = Path('/home/xu/project/loop/DeepScientist/quests/001')
paths = {
    'token_weighted': root/'experiments/stage10/07_large_eval/TOKEN_WEIGHTED_EVAL.csv',
    'recovery_endpoints': root/'experiments/stage10/06_recovery/RECOVERY_ENDPOINTS.csv',

    'state': root/'experiments/stage10/00_freeze/STAGE10_STATE.json',
}

tw = read_csv(paths['token_weighted'])
rec = read_csv(paths['recovery_endpoints'])
seed = read_csv(paths['seed_robustness'])
large = json.loads(paths['large_summary'].read_text())
split = json.loads(paths['split_summary'].read_text())
state = json.loads(paths['state'].read_text())
active_split_rows = split['split_summaries']
result = {
    'token_weighted_eval_rows': len(tw),
    'token_weighted_original_rows': sum(r['source_endpoint_type'] == 'original_reference' for r in tw),
    'token_weighted_y_recover_100m_rows': sum(r['source_endpoint_type'] == 'Y_recover' and r['training_budget_tokens'] == '100000000' for r in tw),
    'token_weighted_model_row_counts': dict(sorted(Counter(r['model_id'] for r in tw).items())),
    'large_eval_summary_status': large['status'],
    'large_eval_summary_evaluated_endpoint_rows': large['evaluated_endpoint_rows'],
    'large_eval_summary_total_table_rows_including_original': large['total_table_rows_including_original'],
    'large_eval_hard_failures': large['hard_failures'],
    'recovery_endpoint_rows': len(rec),
    'recovery_endpoint_status_counts': dict(sorted(Counter(r['status'] for r in rec).items())),
    'recovery_endpoint_type_counts': dict(sorted(Counter(r['endpoint_type'] for r in rec).items())),
    'recovery_endpoint_ledger_rows_state': state['target_write_ledger_rows'],
    'seed_robustness_rows': len(seed),
    'seed_robustness_status_counts': dict(sorted(Counter(r['status'] for r in seed).items())),
    'split_summary_status': split['status'],
    'split_count': split['split_count'],
    'split_record_count': split['record_count'],
    'split_document_count_sum': sum(r['document_count'] for r in active_split_rows),
    'split_status_counts': dict(sorted(Counter(r['status'] for r in active_split_rows).items())),
    'split_model_ids': sorted(r['model_id'] for r in active_split_rows),
    'stage_state_recovery_status': state['recovery_status'],
    'stage_state_large_eval_status': state['large_eval_status'],
    'stage_state_active_substage': state['active_substage'],
}
assert result['token_weighted_eval_rows'] == 366
assert result['token_weighted_original_rows'] == 6
assert result['token_weighted_y_recover_100m_rows'] == 360
assert result['large_eval_summary_total_table_rows_including_original'] == 366
assert result['large_eval_summary_evaluated_endpoint_rows'] == 360
assert result['large_eval_summary_status'] == 'passed_S10-12_large_heldout_eval_alignment_audit'
assert result['large_eval_hard_failures'] == []
assert result['recovery_endpoint_rows'] == 1380
assert result['recovery_endpoint_ledger_rows_state'] == 1380
assert result['seed_robustness_rows'] == 252
assert result['split_count'] == 6
assert result['split_record_count'] == 18789
assert result['split_document_count_sum'] == 18789
assert result['split_status_counts'] == {'passed': 6}
assert result['stage_state_recovery_status'] == 'passed_S10-11_recovery_training_eval'
assert result['stage_state_large_eval_status'] == 'passed_S10-12_large_heldout_eval_alignment_audit'
print(json.dumps(result, sort_keys=True))
PY
